controles.affirmation: Le 20 fevrier 2026, la Cour supreme des Etats-Unis a juge que les droits de douane instaures a partir de 2025 au titre de l'IEEPA n'etaient pas autorises par ce texte
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K 2026-03-31 : "On February 20, 2026, the United States Supreme Court issued a decision that tariffs imposed in 2025 under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act were not authorized under the statute." ; 10-Q 2026-06-02 : "In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a decision that tariffs imposed beginning in 2025 under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (\"IEEPA\") were not authorized under the statute."

controles.affirmation: Les douanes americaines ont ouvert une procedure de remboursement, Ross a depose ses demandes, mais aucune creance ni produit n'est comptabilise au 2 mai 2026 car la realisation n'est pas assuree
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 2026-06-02 : "U.S. Customs and Border Protection has initiated a process for claiming refunds of tariffs paid under IEEPA, and the Company has submitted claims for IEEPA tariffs paid... As of May 2, 2026, the Company has not recognized a receivable or gain relating to tariff refunds because realization was not assured."

controles.affirmation: La societe est visee par des actions de groupe portant sur le droit du travail, principalement en Californie, toujours pendantes au 2 mai 2026 ; elle conteste tout effet significatif
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 2026-06-02 : "Like many retailers, the Company has been named in class/representative action lawsuits, primarily in California, alleging violations by the Company of wage and hour laws. Class/representative action litigation remained pending as of May 2, 2026." ; "The Company believes that the resolution of currently pending class/representative action litigation and other currently pending legal and regulatory proceedings will not have a material adverse effect..."

controles.affirmation: Le vote consultatif sur la remuneration n'a recueilli que 86,0 % d'approbation et le comite a conclu qu'aucune modification majeure n'etait justifiee
controles.verbatim_source: DEF 14A 2026-04-07 : "With respect to last year's Say on Pay proposal, 86.0% of the votes cast were voted \"FOR\" approval of our executive compensation program... concluded that no major changes to our executive compensation policies were warranted as a result of the vote."

controles.affirmation: Ventes a magasins comparables +17 % au T1 2026, dont 11 points de trafic et 6 points de panier, contre 0 % un an plus tot
